verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an identity SaaS like Okta, but the evidence pack never documents retention settings, data deletion controls, or purge policies. The SCIM CRUD material covers provisioning user and group objects to integrated apps. That is an adjacent building block, not a user-facing retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
